The Temptations – Sky’s the Limit
Tamla Motown GS 957
1971 Canadian LP

Classic Temptations album produced by Norman Whitfield, featuring “Just My Imagination (Running Away with Me),” “Smiling Faces Sometimes,” “Gonna Keep on Tryin’ Till I Win Your Love,” and more.

This is a Canadian Tamla Motown pressing, distributed by Ampex Music of Canada.

Condition:
Vinyl visually grades approximately VG/VG+, showing light surface marks and signs of normal handling. Jacket grades approximately VG- to VG with noticeable ring wear, rubbing, edge/corner wear, discoloration and general age-related wear. Please examine all photos carefully for exact cosmetic condition.

Record has not been represented as play-tested unless otherwise noted.

Track highlights:
“Just My Imagination (Running Away with Me)”
“Smiling Faces Sometimes”
“Gonna Keep on Tryin’ Till I Win Your Love”
“I’m the Exception to the Rule”
“Man”
